insight: Serves 12 of the world's top 20 pharmaceutical companies, including Novo Nordisk, Gilead, and Regeneron.
name: Causaly
tagline: Agentic AI for life-sciences R&D, grounded in a biomedical knowledge graph.
description: Causaly is an agentic AI platform for life-sciences research and development that distills tens of millions of scientific publications and datasets into a high-precision biomedical knowledge graph, then lets domain-specific AI agents plan, search, reason, and synthesize evidence. Researchers use it to map biomarkers, molecular targets, and disease mechanisms and to move from hypothesis to evidence-backed decision in hours rather than weeks. It is sold to pharmaceutical and life-sciences enterprises.
edge: Purpose-built for biomedical R&D with a curated 500M-fact knowledge graph, so agents cite verifiable evidence rather than generic web chat.
pros: Distills tens of millions of publications
Built for high-stakes R&D, not generic chat
